description: v1.4 payload convention (SPEC §1.2.6): payload.execution.ref is the source-native run id of the execution that emits THIS event (n8n $execution.id form), while delegation.parent.ref is the run id of the PARENT execution that delegated — the three-way relation with the x-idempotency-key transport header is normative in §1.2.6.
